 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Ayo Dosunmu: So Darius went to play pickup at Metcalfe Park. 5:30 p.m. on a Wednesday. Light outside. Just doing what we loved doing. Playing ball. Then a car drives by. Shots ring out. They weren't trying to hit Darius. He was just a kid, man. Minding his own business. The shots hit him anyway . I was in the shower. My mom was calling me, calling me, calling me...... I got out of the shower, and grabbed the phone and she said, "Darius got shot at the park." "What?" "They took him to the hospital. But …………… he didn't make it."
